## Checklist

- [ ] I have read `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
- [ ] This is a complete feature or a self-contained fix, not a first slice.
- [ ] I understand every line and can explain why it is there.
- [ ] No ROM-derived code or data, no ROM patches, no code copied from other emulators.
- [ ] Machine facts are labelled observed, documented or hypothesis.
- [ ] Tests and `docs/` are updated; it merges onto `main` and CI passes.
